matt.carjoy
I’m still overwhelmed about what to post because there are SO MANY amazing deals.

Today, I’m letting the last 48 hours do the talking.

Cheap. Expensive. Somewhere in between. Here’s what we’ve actually SOLD.

All prices below are MONTHLY LEASE PAYMENTS, structured with first month, tax and bank fee out of pocket.

We also finance and do cash deals, but this list is long enough without turning it into a Cheesecake Factory menu.

🚗 Audi A3 — $529

🚗 Genesis G70 Prestige — $590

🚗 Nissan Altima SV Premium — $299

🚗 Acura ADX — $479
Red interior. SO hot.

🚗 Honda HR-V EX-L — $449

🚗 Subaru Crosstrek Premium — $399

🚗 Audi Q5 — $699
The 2026s are leasing GREAT.

🚗 Hyundai Tucson SE — $399

🚗 Kia Sportage — $449

🚗 Nissan Rogue SV with Cold Weather Package — $409
Because winter is coming, whether we’ve emotionally accepted it or not.

🚗 Genesis GV70 Advanced — $649
Loaded with the good stuff.

🚗 EIGHT Infiniti QX60 Luxes — $599 each
Three rows. One ridiculous deal. Apparently eight families agreed.

🚗 Infiniti QX65 Sport — $669
A little Islanders royalty in the mix: Pat LaFontaine!

🚗 Lexus RX 350 — $649
Liz is officially on the loose.

🚗 Nissan Pathfinder SL — $499

🚗 THREE Range Rover Sports — $1,749 each
Amazing photos coming on these. Stay tuned. Bought 3 and sold 3 at once…

If it isn’t on the list, it just means we haven’t sold it in the last 48 hours. It doesn’t mean we can’t get it.

Meanwhile, my wife and kids think I sleep all day at work.

Sixteen models. Twenty-five vehicles. That’s a pretty productive nap.

#spreadthejoy
